title: 第7章 不灭的尸骸第8章 小灵符术
content_zh:
“林炎来了！”
林炎的出现引起了一阵骚动，如今的林炎已经不再是林家的废物，而是能和林虎一较高下的天之骄子。
当然，林虎并不认可这个说法。
“这小畜生的实力进步的好快，居然都达到养气九重了？”
林雄瞳孔一缩。
他是气海七重的存在，远超出养气境，所以能看得出来林炎的气息波动。
此言一出，祖地外直接掀起一阵倒吸冷气的声音，无数震惊的目光望向林炎：
“什么？养气九重？”
“这小子三天之前，不是才养气六重吗？怎么才三天的时间，就冲到养气九重了？”
甚至就连一些长老，都纳闷了。
他们当年突破一个小境界，恨不得砸锅卖铁，绞尽脑汁，林炎怎么跟吃饭喝水似的？
三个小境界说突破就突破？
还让不让人活了？
“哼，多半是族长他老人家给这小子开小灶了！”
林雄脸色阴霾，身为大长老他在林家的眼线可是很多的，通过渠道他也知道族长林天浩曾召见了林炎。
这也是他为何要对林炎斩尽杀绝的原因。
林天浩对林炎很看重，甚至搞得跟接班人似的，他在林家多年，对族长之位觊觎已久怎么能允许被人半路摘桃子？
“开小灶又怎样，今天他还不是得死！”
林虎眼中闪过一抹寒芒，他的身上气息爆发，比林炎的养气九重都更高一筹，甚至附近的一些长老都被震慑到了：
“气海境？林虎少爷突破气海境了！”

“不愧是林家第一天才啊！”
林家众弟子都露出敬畏之色。
林虎身上爆发的气息，赫然是气海境！
虽然只是气海境一重，可也比养气境强了太多太多！
“突破了？”
林炎倒是并不意外，祭祖大典事关甚大，林虎不可能坐以待毙，一定会竭尽所能的增加实力。
不过就算突破气海境，林炎也无惧。
他养气六重的时候，就能大战养气九重。
如今突破到养气九重，气海境也未必能在他面前讨到什么便宜。
哪怕林虎不是一般的气海境！
“不错，林家这一代出了不少人才。”
这时族长林天浩现身，看到林炎和林虎两人都实力大涨，不由露出欣慰之色。
“族长，祭祖大典赶紧开始吧，时间不早了。”
大长老林雄催促。
林天浩笑了笑，道：
“这次祭祖大典与往届不同，所有修为达到了养气五重以上的天才，都可以进入祖洞内，争取林家老祖留下的机缘。”
“如果谁能将天龙令带出来，便可成为新一任的族长！并且新族长还可以拿着天龙令，去加入天龙剑宗！”
“是！”
众天才都神情振奋。
“祖洞，开启！”

林天浩话音落下，顿时有着几位长老出手，将修为打入祖洞内。
轰！
content_en:
"Lin Yan is here!"
Lin Yan's appearance caused a commotion. Now Lin Yan is no longer a waste of the Lin family, but a proud man who can compete with Lin Hu.
Of course, Lin Hu did not agree with this statement.
"This little beast's strength has improved so fast. He has actually reached the ninth level of Qi Yang?"
Lin Xiong's pupils shrank.
He is a being at the seventh level of the Qi Sea, far beyond the Qi Nourishing Realm, so he can see the fluctuations in Lin Yan's aura.
As soon as these words came out, there was a gasp of air outside the ancestral land, and countless shocked eyes looked at Lin Yan:
"What? The ninth level of nourishing qi?"
"Didn't this kid reach the sixth level of Qi nourishment three days ago? How come he reached the ninth level of Qi nourishment in just three days?"
Even some elders were puzzled.
They had broken through a small realm back then, and they wanted to smash the pot and sell iron, racking their brains. How could Lin Yan act like he was eating and drinking?
Are there any breakthroughs in the three small realms?
Are you going to let people live?
"Hmph, it's probably the clan leader who has given this kid some trouble!"
Lin Xiong's face was gloomy. As the elder, he had many eyes in the Lin family. Through channels, he also knew that the clan leader, Lin Tianhao, had summoned Lin Yan.
This was also the reason why he wanted to kill Lin Yan.
Lin Tianhao valued Lin Yan very much, and even regarded him as his successor. He had been in the Lin family for many years and had coveted the position of patriarch for a long time. How could he allow someone to pick the peaches halfway?
"It doesn't matter if he turns on a small stove, he still has to die today!"
A cold light flashed in Lin Hu's eyes, and the aura on his body exploded, which was higher than Lin Yan's ninth level of Qi nourishment. Even some elders nearby were shocked:
"Qi Sea Realm? Young Master Lin Hu has broken through the Qi Sea Realm!"
"He is indeed the number one genius of the Lin family!"
All the disciples of the Lin family showed awe.
The aura that erupted from Lin Hu's body was clearly from the Qi Sea realm!
Although it is only the first level of the Qi Sea Realm, it is much stronger than the Qi Nourishing Realm!
"Breakthrough?"
Lin Yan was not surprised. The ancestor worship ceremony was of great importance. Lin Hu could not sit still and wait for death. He would definitely do his best to increase his strength.
But even if he breaks through the Qi Sea realm, Lin Yan has no fear.
When he reaches the sixth level of Qi nourishment, he can fight against the ninth level of Qi nourishment.
Now that he has broken through to the ninth level of Qi Yang, he may not be able to get any advantage in the Qi Sea realm in front of him.
Even if Lin Hu is not in the ordinary Qi Sea realm!
"Yes, this generation of the Lin family has produced many talents."
At this time, the clan leader Lin Tianhao appeared. Seeing that Lin Yan and Lin Hu had greatly increased their strength, he couldn't help but look pleased.
"Clan leader, hurry up and start the ancestor worship ceremony. It's getting late."
Great Elder Lin Xiong urged.
Lin Tianhao smiled and said:
"This ancestor worship ceremony is different from previous ones. All geniuses who have reached the fifth level of Qi nourishment or above can enter the ancestral cave and strive for the opportunities left by the ancestors of the Lin family."
"Whoever can bring out the Heavenly Dragon Order can become the new patriarch! And the new patriarch can also take the Heavenly Dragon Order and join the Tianlong Sword Sect!"
"Yes!"
All the geniuses looked excited.
"Ancestral Cave, open!"
As soon as Lin Tianhao finished speaking, several elders took action and drove the cultivation base into the ancestral cave.
boom!
